# Run book: Sign in with Keycloak

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/sign-in.md) | [Spec](../specs/sign-in.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Authenticate with OpenID Connect and PKCE so the SPA and API handle only tokens, never passwords.

## Preconditions

- The compose stack is running with sign-in on (the default) and the `oobdev-example` realm imported.
- Use the sample user `ada` (password `ada`) or `grace` (password `grace`, also an admin).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Sign in with Keycloak"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/identity/me`:

1. **Get sent to the identity provider.** Every screen needs a token, so the application sends you to Keycloak. The application never sees your password. Expect: The Keycloak sign-in form is shown.
2. **Enter your credentials.** Type the user name and password of a sample user and sign in. Expect: You return to the screen you asked for. The header shows your user name.
3. **Read your claims.** The current user screen lists the claims the API read from your access token. Expect: The preferred user name claim is listed.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Redirect error invalid_redirect_uri | The client redirect URIs do not include this origin | Update the realm client or re-import the realm (remove the Keycloak volume) |
| Credentials rejected | Wrong sample user | See containers/example/keycloak/dev-users.md |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Identity; OoBDev.AspNetCore.JwtAuthentication; Keycloak (authorization code with PKCE).
